cohort: The study analyzed 1200 birth records of pregnant women with hypertension and their neonates admitted to the Neonatal Intensive Care Unit of a hospital.
finding: There was a statistical association between DBP and newborn weight, with women having DBP >=110 mmHg presenting a smaller mean newborn weight compared to the group with DBP <=110 mmHg.
gest_age: Maximum women in the study had term pregnancies.
